# Hackera

> Hackera is a Bulgarian catalog of 250 digital services in 20 categories (web development, SEO, marketing, design, cybersecurity, AI and more), plus a "Website as a Service" subscription. Operated by Имоти 98 ЕООД. Contact: ivan@hackera.online

Languages: English (https://hackera.online/services/) and Bulgarian (https://hackera.online/bg/uslugi/).

## Web Development
- [Web Development: all 20 services](https://hackera.online/services/web-development/)
- [Business Website Development](https://hackera.online/services/web-development/business-website-development/): A modern site with all core pages, ready to represent your business online.
- [Online Stores (E-commerce)](https://hackera.online/services/web-development/online-stores/): A full store with catalog, cart and checkout for selling online.
- [WordPress Development](https://hackera.online/services/web-development/wordpress-development/): Building a site on WordPress — flexible and easy to maintain yourself.

## SEO Services
- [SEO Services: all 15 services](https://hackera.online/services/seo-services/)
